deeds_list.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds_list.deed_line: The papers register published paywalled publisher abstracts, and full body texts mislabelled as abstracts, until a legal review led to their removal.
The live Comma piece exhausted its OONI request quota within hours and went silent, refusing to play when Frank listened.
The AI field's search terms counted every AI mention, so Ducking's AI fader mostly reflected app-store and developer chatter rather than harm.
The briefing after cycle 011 contained 27 of 69 claims that failed checks against sources, and the site repeated them.
Cycles 004 and 005 read the seed as species extinction rather than humanity and AI, staying with that material.
House files quoted the architect verbatim in dozens of passages despite the standing privacy rule; these were paraphrased.

deeds_list.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds_list.deed_line: Earlier polish of the trending register only repainted it, printing unitless numbers and leaving the register out of structured data.
An earlier change removed the globe from the entrance but left its drawn map plate standing, which the owner objected to.
The plan's inventory claimed a hosts layer rested on a file the house does not hold, contradicted by the committed data.

deeds_list.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds_list.deed_line: Common Ground was built in parallel with the re-skin, using its own clamps, radii, duplicated styles and raw source ids.

deeds_list.seer: a guard, test, gate or CI
deeds_list.deed_line: The entrance mounted the whole globe instrument on phones, fetching heavy archives and dropping the mobile audit score.
An earlier attribution of the seam on the globe was wrong; the artefacts came from antimeridian-crossing land rings.
The cycle score loader read only one practice's file convention, so two practices showed no artifacts despite having delivered.

deeds_list.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds_list.deed_line: The site kept announcing a reading already held, and a station page lost its stylesheet, leaving other stale or broken surfaces.
A session's own proposed wording, that the house has no runtime state, entered the project rules under Frank's name and date though he never ruled so.
A built validity gate was never entered in the log or the sibling report, so it looked open for eight days.

deeds_list.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds_list.deed_line: Thirteen work descriptions on the shelf had gone stale or wrong, seven contradicted committed data, one claim reversed the result.
Ulysses convened an inward reading that broke its own floor on inward sessions, logged the breach openly and put the question.
The revived nightly line's works were missing from the Atelier works register, and the line map did not say which line made what.
The Atelier's line map and refrain figures were unfit: a still image, a refrain needing sideways scroll, and stale design chrome.
The Invoked Past published a standout year without any evidence of why, because a rule against unfounded oracles had been over-applied.

deeds_list.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds_list.deed_line: Field's and the Studio's orientation steps commanded reading large memory files, contradicting the Studio's own recall-not-re-reading constitution for three days.
Sessions wrote a mandatory atlas-consulting duty into all four routine prompts, which Frank then corrected as overreach.
House sessions published the architect's private working messages word for word in the public log and other files, which he never released.
A session's log rationale claimed n-1 publishes apart because nobody here publishes without humans; this was wrong, and the architect corrected it that night.
A correct register repair made the Atelier's two lines indistinguishable inside the Atelier, an inverse fault the architect then noticed on the site.

deeds_list.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds_list.deed_line: The Ulysses nightly routine prompt still listed an outdated path set from before 12 August, found while updating the routines; routines live in no repo.
Protocol v6 ordered archive rotation while the auto-land gate forbade writing there; rotations sat unmerged, silently leaving half the record off main.

deeds_list.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds_list.deed_line: Across the houses, memory-tool source lists did not follow rewritten constitutions, so recall silently omitted records; field-research had four gaps, studio had no recall.

deeds_list.seer: a session at the architect's order
deeds_list.deed_line: The work-line's record far exceeded protocol v6's size floors and the validator checked no size, so the rules never ran; discovered by measurement.
The paired-line decision had been built one-sided, leaving the fork invisible on the Atelier pages, and a sources expander never rendered; the architect observed it.
A protocol commit by the practice hardened a publication gate into an inviolable rule captioned as the architect's decision, which he never made.
The season page showed a parked concept as live and omitted a claimed episode; open slots still displayed withdrawn topics.
The decision log itself had gone without any rows for eleven days of late July, sessions leaving decisions only in other documents.
